meta.seo_description: Free download of 333 country languages, ISO codes, and country names. Available in Excel, CSV, and PDF for data analysis and development needs.
meta.title: Country Languages & ISO Codes Dataset
meta.description: This dataset provides a comprehensive list of 333 country-language associations, including ISO Alpha-2 and Alpha-3 codes, country names, language codes, and language names. Ideal for global data analysis.
key_takeaways: Access 333 records detailing country-language relationships globally.
Explore ISO Alpha-2/Alpha-3 country codes and associated language data.
Download comprehensive country language data in multiple formats.
Leverage structured data for internationalization and linguistic analysis.
use_cases: Import the **CSV** file into your SQL database or Python scripts to build multilingual applications or analyze linguistic distribution.
Use the **Excel** file to create Pivot Tables, filter countries by language, or perform VLOOKUPs for data enrichment in your reports.
Print the **PDF** version for a quick reference guide in classrooms, presentations, or for offline research on global languages.
Integrate this dataset into educational platforms or translation tools to provide accurate country-language mappings.
